papers.title: Islander's note
lines: The Potato Patches are a half-day walk on the volcano's skirt. We farm them in common.
The cows are known by name and so is the weather. Both are unpredictable.

papers.title: Evacuation diary, 1961
lines: We were taken off the island in the night, by boat, with what we could carry.
In England we saw trains and buses. We did not like them. We went home as soon as we were asked.

papers.title: Crawfish note
lines: The Tristan rock lobster is the island's living. We catch it, pack it, ship it, and eat the leftover tails.
Anyone who says 'crayfish' is corrected, gently. It is a crawfish, and it knows it.

papers.title: Knitter's pattern
lines: The islanders' woollen hats are knitted in the evenings by the fire, from island wool.
One rule: a bobble of defiant size.
